_note: PROC-013 door family. Door facts (type, leaf size, hinge/swing, hardware, closer, lock, defaultState) are read live from doors_json (Docs/Reference/DOORS.json, REF-013) and never copied here. This file holds only construction values: each is sourced in `_src` or is a labelled placeholder carrying a GAP-DOOR-n id (DEC-047). Wall thickness per door = the graybox wall `t` (graybox_layout.json, GAP-104) floored at the frame family's minimum depth.

wear._src: GAP-DOOR-9: wear amounts are placeholders for the materials pass

hm._src: Flush hollow-metal leaf 1-3/4 in thick (TI A310 / REFERENCES_INDEX 6.2, High). Frame face, stop, rabbet inset, undercut, hinge layout and hardware sizes are commercial conventions (GAP-DOOR-1). Lever / exit-device centreline 3'-5" inside the A310 band 3'-4" to 3'-6" (REFERENCES_INDEX 6.2, High).

storefront._src: TI E101 existing aluminium full-glass storefront pair, 6'-0" x 7'-0", two 3'-0" leaves (REFERENCES_INDEX 6.2, High); GL-1 green-tinted glass (6.5, High); pull centreline 3'-6" (A310, 6.2, High). Stile/rail widths, frame section, glass thickness, pull size, threshold and hinge type are not on any sheet or still (GAP-DOOR-2).

arch._src: Cased opening 3'-0" x 7'-0" (A101 keynote 10, REFERENCES_INDEX 6.2/6.4, High; DOORS.json clearOpening). White gypsum lining with rounded top corners and no casing trim, set in the wood-slat wall (BAND 06 / 01, REFERENCES_INDEX 3; PT-1 SW7646 First Star, 6.5). Corner radius measured on BAND 06: ~50 px on a ~245 px opening = 0.6 ft (Low). Whether 7'-0" is the crown or the spring line is not drawn: crown used (GAP-DOOR-3).

grille._src: TI 101B side-folding open-air security grille, clear anodized, 16'-4 3/4" x 7'-6" (REFERENCES_INDEX 6.2, High; DOORS.json). Not placed (DEC-037). Picket pitch/section, lattice and track sizes are conventions; the 18 in access door is not modelled (GAP-DOOR-4).

finishes._src: Preview PBR values (base RGBA, metallic, roughness). The 2K texture sets come from the PROC-010 materials pass; slot names are the contract.
